title: GoodWe ESA GW20K-ETA-G20 (20 kW three-phase power module)

items.question: What backup rating does GW20K-ETA-G20 have?
items.answer: The GW20K-ETA-G20 has a rated apparent power of 20 kVA on the AC side (Back-up Port).
items.answer_de: Der GW20K-ETA-G20 hat eine Nennscheinleistung von 20 kVA auf der AC-Seite (Back-up Port).

items.question: How many MPPTs does GW20K-ETA-G20 have?
items.question_de: Wie viele MPPTs hat der GW20K-ETA-G20?

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)

items.question: Which battery modules stack with this power module?
items.answer: The battery modules that can be used are GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20, and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Battery modules of different models can be mixed.
items.question_de: Welche Batteriemodule gehören zu diesem Leistungsmodul?
items.answer_de: Die verwendbaren Batteriemodule sind GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 und GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Batteriemodule unterschiedlicher Modelle können gemischt werden.
